tasks.instruction: Standard StepFun and StepFun-CN Chat completions report cached_tokens as an inclusive subset of prompt_tokens. Recognize it only with trusted provider and request/response format context, including JSON and terminal cumulative SSE. Keep observed input and total tokens inclusive; reject invalid or contradictory cache evidence without retaining an earlier valid cache count. Pass the trusted context through response observation. Preserve other providers, subscription lanes and formats.

Native Cohere Chat reports observed usage.tokens separately from usage.billed_units, including terminal SSE message-end events. Preserve observed input/output/total values in usage reports, carry separately validated billedTokens, and calculate native Cohere cost only from billed units. Missing or malformed billing data must leave cost unknown; explicit zero billed units remain valid. Preserve other formats, cumulative SSE semantics, backpressure and cancellation.

Native fal music File content_type must be a scalar MIME string when present. Reject arrays, objects, booleans and numbers rather than accepting them through string coercion. Preserve the allowed MP3/WAV MIME variants, absent/null MIME handling, URL/size validation and bounded response behavior.
